subtitle: Project: runbook-copilot. Answers IT incident questions from a folder of runbooks, with a step limit and human approval.

rows.title: A. The agent loop: look it up, then answer

cards.title: 1. A question comes in
cards.body: Someone asks about an IT incident, like a full disk or a slow web server.

cards.title: 2. The model picks a tool
cards.body: The model thinks, then asks to use search_runbooks.

cards.title: 3. Code runs the search
cards.body: Your code searches the runbooks and hands back the best matching sections, each with a score.

cards.title: 4. Answer or search again
cards.body: The model answers with the runbook cited, or searches again. Limit: 4 steps (MAX_STEPS = 4).

rows.title: B. Safe actions: a person says yes first

cards.title: Model proposes an action
cards.body: Instead of only answering, the model can propose execute_action.

cards.title: Human approval click
cards.body: Nothing is run without a person saying yes.

cards.title: Declined means nothing
cards.body: If the person says no, the action does nothing at all.

cards.title: Honest failures
cards.body: Says "I could not find this in the runbooks." Stops after 2 empty or weak searches in a row, or at the step limit (PR 5, Oct 31).

rows.title: C. Tested without a real model

cards.title: Practice model
cards.body: A fake model that always gives the same reply, so tests are repeatable.

cards.title: 200+ tests with fakes
cards.body: Tests check the loop, the tools and the stopping rules with no API key.

cards.title: git commit + pull request
cards.body: Work on a branch, then ask to merge it into main so changes are reviewed.

cards.title: CI runs the tests
cards.body: GitHub Actions runs every test on each push and shows pass or fail.

keys.title: Agent loop
keys.body: Think, use a tool, look at the result, repeat until done.

keys.title: RAG
keys.body: Look things up first, then answer with sources.

keys.title: Tools
keys.body: Functions the model can ask your code to run, like search_runbooks.

keys.title: Human approval
keys.body: A person must say yes before any action runs.

keys.title: Step limit
keys.body: A cap of 4 steps so the loop can never run forever.

keys.title: Practice model for testing
keys.body: A fake model with fixed replies makes tests fast, free and repeatable.
